value.text: no. 122, Medicine, Anatomy, Astrology and Miscellany

claims.statement: Entered as no. 122 in the reconstructed catalogue of Leonardo's books, under Medicine, Anatomy, Astrology and Miscellany. Leonardo's wording as rendered there: "Francesco da Siena".
check_in: Leonardo's autograph book lists: Codex Trivulzianus f. 2r; Codex Atlanticus f. 559r; Madrid Codex II ff. 2v to 3r (which list names this title to be established)

claims.statement: Identified in the reconstruction as Trattato di architettura (?). The identification of a title in Leonardo's lists with a specific work and edition is an interpretation.
Composition and printing as given in the reconstruction: Composition unknown, possibly 1480s · Manuscript.
check_in: ISTC (Incunabula Short Title Catalogue) or Edit16 record for the edition

background.text: A work by a Francesco of Siena; very plausibly Francesco di Giorgio Martini, in which case this entry may denote the treatise on architecture that survives today with Leonardo's marginal notes.
